identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18A-HTML] Complete the HTML Observatory Runtime v3 client

values.goal: Make the existing HTML Observatory a truthful live consumer of Runtime v3 HTTPS and WSS without changing Runtime or Unity.
values.required_outcome: The real browser renders fresh Runtime state, executes only authorized controls, exposes failures explicitly, and reconnects without duplicate events or authority escalation.
declared_scope: HTML Observatory Runtime v3 client state and interaction behavior
Browser styling required for explicit live, stale, denied, and unavailable states
authority_boundary: Runtime API, WSS, TLS, launch, and authentication behavior are read-only upstream contracts
Unity files and proof belong to issue #84
Shared Guardian restart coordination and final cross-client reconciliation belong to issue #5837
operator_constraints: Do not substitute fixtures, cached packets, or static screenshots for live proof
Do not expose tokens, signing material, private citizen state, or sealed checkpoints
Do not bind or implement until explicitly authorized
